zh.title: MLS 和线上推广：卖家要知道的规则和选择
zh.seo_title: MLS 与线上推广：卖家指南｜陈靖
zh.description: MLS 是房源信息流向各大网站的主要起点。本文说明 MLS 怎么运作、Clear Cooperation 和 Delayed Marketing 的规则，以及 2024 年 NAR 和解后买方经纪报酬的做法有什么变化。
zh.lead: 你在各大房产网站上看到的房源，大多数从 MLS 而来。了解它的规则，才能判断要不要全面上市、什么时候上市。

en.title: MLS and Online Exposure: Rules and Choices for Sellers
en.seo_title: MLS and Online Exposure for Home Sellers | Jing Chen
en.description: How the MLS feeds listing sites, what Clear Cooperation and delayed marketing mean, and how buyer-agent pay changed after the 2024 NAR settlement.
en.lead: Most listings on home search sites start in the MLS. Knowing its rules helps you decide whether, when and how widely to go to market.
